brief:
# Assessment

Choose refresh-keyring before approving the image. Use the official replacement-key verification procedure; never bypass signature verification to keep updates working.

The current GitHub CLI Linux repository PGP key expires on September 5, 2026.

The first subsequent release signs APT/RPM metadata and new RPM packages with only the replacement key.

A keyring containing both current and replacement keys was published in April 2026.
